gizmo.title: Umbuzo wenani
gizmo.description: Umbuzo ophendulwa ngenani. Impendulo linani elizinzileyo okanye ifomula esonjululwa kwizinto eziguquguqukayo, kwaye iyabalwa xa ingaphakathi kokunyamezelwa.

configure.title: Umbuzo
configure.description: Oko abafundi babuzwa kona. Bhala igama lento eguquguqukayo kwizibiyeli ezigoso, njenge-{d}, ukubonisa ixabiso layo.

configure.title: Iyunithi
configure.description: Iboniswa njengesicatshulwa ecaleni kwendawo yempendulo, umzekelo km/h.

configure.title: Impendulo
configure.description: Inani elichanekileyo. Shiya kungenanto xa ifomula isonjulula impendulo.

configure.title: Ifomula
configure.description: Isonjulula impendulo kwizinto eziguquguqukayo, umzekelo d / (t / 60). Ingasebenzisa + - * / ^, izibiyeli, sqrt() kunye ne-abs(). Isetyenziswa endaweni yempendulo xa isetiwe.

configure.title: Izinto eziguquguqukayo
configure.description: Amanani asetyenziswa yifomula nombuzo. Ngalinye lithatha ixabiso phakathi kwelona lisezantsi nelona liphezulu, ngamanyathelo.

advanced.title: Ukunyamezela
advanced.description: Kude kangakanani kwimpendulo echanekileyo kusabalwa. 0 kuthetha ngqo, okanye kujikelezwe kwiindawo zedesimali ezingezantsi.

advanced.title: Uhlobo lokunyamezela
advanced.description: Ngokupheleleyo: dibanisa okanye uthabathe ukunyamezela. Ipesenti: dibanisa okanye uthabathe loo pesenti yempendulo echanekileyo.

advanced.title: Iindawo zedesimali
advanced.description: Abafundi bacelwa ukuba bajikeleze kwezi ndawo, kwaye impendulo iboniswa ijikelezwe kuzo. Shiya kungenanto ukuba akukho kujikeleza.

advanced.title: Amanani amatsha kwinzame nganye
advanced.description: Khupha amaxabiso amatsha ezinto eziguquguqukayo ngalo lonke ixesha umfundi ezama kwakhona. Impendulo yakhe yangaphambili ayiboniswa xa ebuya, kuphela ukuba ebeyichanile na.

advanced.title: Iyasongeka
advanced.description: Bonisa lo mbuzo njengomqolo ovulekayo novalekayo. Ukuvula omnye kuvala eminye imibuzo esongekayo ecaleni kwawo.

advanced.title: Qala usongiwe
advanced.description: Xa isongeka, qala njengomqolo ovaliweyo obonisa umbuzo nesimo sawo kuphela.

developer.title: Igama lovavanyo
developer.description: Igama lovavanyo elisetyenziselwa ukuchonga kwe-xAPI kwiinkqubo zohlalutyo.
